remarks: Welcome to your New Canaan retreat. Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac, this beautifully updated home offers modern comfort and timeless charm. The remodeled kitchen and baths sparkle, complemented by handsome hardwood floors. With three bedrooms, an airy open living and dining area, and a spacious lower-level rec room that opens to a private deck, there's room for both relaxation and entertaining. Step outside to enjoy both decks overlooking colorful autumn foliage and the gentle sounds of a nearby brook. Stroll into town for award-winning dining, boutique shopping, or an easy Metro-North ride into NYC. Close to top-rated schools, parks, the Olympic-size town pool, and all the best of New Canaan living. Freshly updated, move-in ready, and waiting for your next chapter.
